ax:
- main:
  - heading "Celestia" [level=1]
  - paragraph: An independent project for exploring Zi Wei Dou Shu charts.
  - region "Check birth inputs":
    - heading "Check birth inputs" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Check a date, local time, and birthplace time zone. Chart calculation is not available yet.
    - paragraph: This form checks entries in your browser. Entries are not sent, saved, or logged by the application.
    - group "Birth details":
      - text: Birth details
      - alert:
        - paragraph: "Please correct the following fields:"
        - list:
          - listitem:
            - 'link "Birth date (required): Enter a birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format."':
              - /url: "#birth-date"
          - listitem:
            - 'link "Birth time (required): Enter a birth time in 24-hour HH:MM format."':
              - /url: "#birth-time"
          - listitem:
            - 'link "Birth location time zone (required): Enter the birth location’s time zone, such as America/Los_Angeles or UTC."':
              - /url: "#birth-timeZone"
      - text: Birth date (required)
      - paragraph: Use the Gregorian calendar and YYYY-MM-DD format.
      - textbox "Birth date (required)" [invalid]:
        - /placeholder: 2000-01-15
      - paragraph: Enter a birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
      - text: Birth time (required)
      - paragraph: Enter the local clock time at birth in 24-hour HH:MM format, to the minute.
      - textbox "Birth time (required)" [invalid]:
        - /placeholder: 14:30
      - paragraph: Enter a birth time in 24-hour HH:MM format.
      - text: Birth location time zone (required)
      - paragraph: Use an IANA zone for the birthplace, such as Asia/Shanghai or America/Los_Angeles, or UTC. Your device’s zone is not selected automatically.
      - textbox "Birth location time zone (required)" [invalid]:
        - /placeholder: Asia/Shanghai
      - paragraph: Enter the birth location’s time zone, such as America/Los_Angeles or UTC.
      - button "Check inputs"
    - status

fields.label: Birth date (required)
fields.description: Use the Gregorian calendar and YYYY-MM-DD format. Enter a birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
fields.error: Enter a birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

fields.label: Birth time (required)
fields.description: Enter the local clock time at birth in 24-hour HH:MM format, to the minute. Enter a birth time in 24-hour HH:MM format.
fields.error: Enter a birth time in 24-hour HH:MM format.

fields.label: Birth location time zone (required)
fields.description: Use an IANA zone for the birthplace, such as Asia/Shanghai or America/Los_Angeles, or UTC. Your device’s zone is not selected automatically. Enter the birth location’s time zone, such as America/Los_Angeles or UTC.
fields.error: Enter the birth location’s time zone, such as America/Los_Angeles or UTC.

alerts: Please correct the following fields:Birth date (required): Enter a birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format.Birth time (required): Enter a birth time in 24-hour HH:MM format.Birth location time zone (required): Enter the birth location’s time zone, such as America/Los_Angeles or UTC.
